text:
Explicit structural revision limited to the existing data-adaptation composition. Preserve the accepted requirements byte-for-byte, including the single query input, non-null row objects with nullable nom/description/prix fields, maxItems 10, all business operations, real per-product visits, output writer path, and unconditional Browser closure. Preserve business order. Do not omit work or replace a writer output with a literal.

The current artifact is not approved for execution. Correct these concrete review findings using existing bindings only:
1. detect_search_gate, choose_search_results_scope, extract_first_product_links and extract_product_row directly feed complete observationSnapshot/content into global interpret. Insert one compact typed extract-mode each view over the complete observationSnapshot.pages for each immediate decision stage where sufficient. Retain original observations separately; keep complete-snapshot guards on original producer metadata. Feed only the necessary declared facts/IDs to global interpretation, never raw snapshots/content alongside the compact view. Pages must remain bounded complete items. Do not flatten all raw records into a single oversized mapping.each invocation.
2. Project fields from each typed page-view object inside foreach item, grouping related exports, then flatten the exported arrays exactly one level. For example: extract each -> views; foreach views: body.outputs.candidates=field(item,candidates); flatten(output(loop,candidates)). Never field(array,...), even for index/length. Typed copying uses value/direct bindings; already typed product rows must not be re-extracted.
3. A decision selects observed candidate IDs only. Validate selected IDs by lookup against the offered compact candidates, then lookup against retained original records. lookup always takes/returns arrays; iterate even a singleton before accessing object fields. Obtain actual URLs, references, selectors and supported actions from the original records, not model-regenerated arguments. Preserve selected order and repeated selections. Producer action compatibility and snapshot-expiration checks remain authoritative. No invented selectors, fallback references or URLs.
4. Remove the unrequested deduplication criterion from extract_first_product_links. Preserve the first observed products, at most ten, without sponsored filtering, deduplication or invented business criteria. Do not manufacture a synthetic product row for blocked/incomplete observations. Missing fields of a genuinely visited product may remain null; incomplete acquisition is an explicit failure, not proof of no products.
5. Replace finalize_rows with value/direct typed one-level flatten/assembly. It must preserve observed typed rows exactly and return the unchanged accepted non-null row contract. Retain make_excel_tsv as the previously authorized bounded formatting interpretation over at most ten compact rows.

Preserve the existing operation identities, contracts, actual navigation, conditional observed consent action, search, product loop, write and cleanup. Their consumer bindings and surrounding pure adapters may change only to implement this correction. Keep every existing required assertion. No new executor, operator, script, interface, limit, permission or repair mechanism. Do not increase any bound or use a declarative boolean as proof of another value's type/cardinality/completeness. The compiler and runtime will validate the entire revised plan.
